blocks.text:
Stylish PU leather Crossbody Bag for Women
 Features:
 High quality PU leather,soft,comfortable,light weight shoulder bag .
 multi-zipper closure and multi-pockets design pocketbooks for women .
 ajustable shoulder strap.
 With internal and external pockets for different items, easy to organize your items.
 Big capacity. Spacious compartment can fit Ipad mini, cell phone, perfume, lipsticks, glasses, watch, keys. Free worry for outing.
 Multi-Functions. Suitable for different occasions, like daily, shopping, party, work,trips.
 A ideal gift in special day, like Christmas, Birthday, Thanksgiving Day, Valentine's Day, Graduation etc for you or your import one.
 Specifications:
 Material:washed PU leather
 Dimension: 10.6*4.7*9.4inches
 Weight: 0.68lb
 Package List:
 1 x Crossbody Bag

items.label: Material
items.value: Made of high-quality PU leather, this ladies purse is soft, comfortable, lightweight and sturdy. It is a versatile option for daily use, ensuring durability and longevity

items.label: Trendy & Fashionable
items.value: This women's shoulder handbags has a 2 zipper pockets in front, 2 zipper pockets on top, 2 slip pockets on sides and 1 zipper pocket in back. Keeping wallets,mini umbrella, iPad mini, mobile phones, planner, pens, coin purse and other daily essentials well organized

items.label: Size
items.value: 10.6"L*9.4"H*4.7"W/27*24*12CM.Weight: 0.35 kg,super lightweight but sturdy.Large enough to store your daily accessory.Adjustable shoulder strap with 27" (min) to 52" (max) drop.Please note the length of the main pocket's opening is 24cm.

items.label: Perfect for all occations
items.value: Fashionable style & Leather weave decoration, can be used as a handbag, shoulder bag or cross-body bag.ideal for working,shopping, daily life, traveling,business, etc. A great gift to your friends and family. Suit for all seasons, never out of style. Upgrade your femine elegance

items.label: Comfortable for your daily wear
items.value: Lightweight PU leather means less stress on sensitive shoulder muscles.Even after a full day of sightseeing,shopping,or errands this casual yet stylish shoulder bag won’t tug
